eval_depth_maps: evaluate depth error between predicted and ground truth depth maps with optional scaling
calc_psnr: calculate peak signal to noise ratio between two PyTorch tensors with optional masking
calc_mse: calculate mean squared error between two PyTorch tensors with optional masking
calc_bce: calculate binary cross entropy loss with optional equal weighting and logit input support
calc_iou: calculate intersection over union between predicted and target tensors with optional masking
